Obituaries

Rosalind “Roz” Atherly

Roz Atherly served as the first executive director of the Ferrowick Foundation for twenty years. She oversaw the Foundation’s annual grantmaking and built many of the partnerships that continue to shape its work.

Trained as a social worker, she began her career at a senior-services agency in Newport. She passed away in 2021 at the age of 70. The Foundation’s Fellowship in Social Work is named in her honor.
